# routeros_ip_service_webserver (Resource)
Settings of `/ip service webserver`: which applications the `www` (HTTP, `*_plain`) and `www-ssl` (HTTPS, `*_secure`) services serve. Deleting the resource only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
# Serve REST and WebFig only over www-ssl (HTTPS).
resource "routeros_ip_service_webserver" "this" {
  rest_plain    = false
  rest_secure   = true
  webfig_plain  = false
  webfig_secure = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `acme_plain` (Boolean) Serve ACME HTTP-01 challenge responses over `www` (HTTP).
- `crl_plain` (Boolean) Serve certificate revocation lists over `www` (HTTP).
- `graphs_plain` (Boolean) Serve graphs (`/tool graphing`) over `www` (HTTP).
- `graphs_secure` (Boolean) Serve graphs (`/tool graphing`) over `www-ssl` (HTTPS).
- `index_plain` (Boolean) Serve the start page over `www` (HTTP).
- `index_secure` (Boolean) Serve the start page over `www-ssl` (HTTPS).
- `rest_plain` (Boolean) Serve the REST API over `www` (HTTP).
- `rest_secure` (Boolean) Serve the REST API over `www-ssl` (HTTPS).
- `scep_plain` (Boolean) Serve the SCEP server over `www` (HTTP).
- `webfig_plain` (Boolean) Serve WebFig over `www` (HTTP).
- `webfig_secure` (Boolean) Serve WebFig over `www-ssl` (HTTPS).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_ip_service_webserver.this .
```
